meta.title: 산책왕 멍멍
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (산책왕 멍멍, a dog-walking app (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Saturday-morning flats inside thick #1B1B1B ink: sky #6EC8FF, grass #7ED957, a tan dog #F4A259 with a white muzzle, a red collar #FF5A5F, star and crown yellow #FFD23F, numbers in blue #3D7CFF.
rationale.type: Black Han Sans for the shouted lines, in white or yellow with an ink outline and a hard drop; Jua for small lines and names.
rationale.motion: Cartoon physics: smears and speed lines, skids with puffs, squash on every stop, rubber-hose legs on a run cycle, a tail that never stops, stars and burst balloons that pop with an overshoot, a podium the dogs drop onto.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 144 BPM in C major (9 bars in 15 s, 18 in 30 s), pluck, marimba and bell over a full kit; cartoon SFX: whips for the entrances, pops and boings for the balloons and landings, a confirm for the crown.
rationale.visuals: All code: inked paths with one shadow tone, 멍멍 built from ellipses and hose legs, a scrolling park, a phone card that counts steps, a podium on sunburst rays, a map with a dotted route and paw prints.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the dog speaks for itself.
